payload.title: LERM applied to ODP cores
payload.summary: This notebook applies the Local Embedding Reconstruction Method (LERM) to Ocean Drilling Program (ODP) cores to recreate Figure 2 from a publication focused on the Mid-Pleistocene-Transition (MPT). It involves loading time series data from the LR04 stack, processing it to exclude discontinuities, and applying LERM with specific parameters such as embedding dimension and recurrence density. The notebook uses various scientific computing libraries to handle data processing and visualization.
goals: Recreate Figure 2 from the original publication using LERM.
Apply LERM to ODP cores over the Mid-Pleistocene-Transition.

section_blurbs.blurb: The section describes the process of applying LERM to ODP cores, focusing on loading and processing time series data from the LR04 stack. It includes handling discontinuities and setting parameters for LERM application, such as embedding dimension and recurrence density.
section_blurbs.heading: LERM applied to ODP cores

outputs: Recreated Figure 2 from the original publication
